title: Te Kaitiaki o tētahi Tohu Atua
intro: I roto i te wāhi tapu, i atawhaitia tētahi wairua tapu i raro i te manaakitanga o te Atua. I whakaritea tēnei tangata kia whai wāhi nui ki tētahi huihuinga merekara, kia noho hei tohu mō te mana mutunga kore me te whakaaro nui o Allah. Nā tā rātou haerenga i hura he pono hohonu, i wero i ngā tirohanga me te whakatū i tētahi tohu ahurei mō te tangata katoa.
clues: I whiriwhiria ahau e Allah, i purea hoki i runga ake i ngā wāhine katoa o tōku wā.
I tukuna ahau ki raro i te mana tiaki o tētahi poropiti tika, ā, i kitea e ia he kai i roto i taku rūma inoi i roto i te merekara.
I wehe atu ahau i tōku whānau ki tētahi wāhi tūmataiti hei karakia ki a Allah.
I puta mai tētahi anahera ki ahau i roto i te āhua o tētahi tangata tino tika, e kawe mai ana i ngā rongopai mō tētahi tama parakore, ahakoa kāore ahau i mōhio ki tētahi tāne.
I muri i ngā mamae o te whānautanga, i whakahaua ahau kia rūrūtia te take o te nikau kia kitea he kai hou.
I taku hokinga atu ki tōku iwi e waha ana i taku pēpi hou, ka pātai mai rātou ki ahau, engari i kōrero whakamiharo taku tamaiti pēpi mai anō i te whanga hei tiaki i ahau.

identity.label: Ko wai ahau?
options: Hera (te wahine a te Poropiti a Ihāperahama)
Hajar (whaea o te Poropiti a Ihimaera)
Bilqis (Kuīni o Sheba)
Āsiya (wahine a Parao)
Meri (Mēri)

trial.label: Whakamātautau/Takahanga
options: He waipuke nui i whakangaro i tētahi iwi whakaponokore
Te maka ki roto i te ahi mura mō te whakakahore i ngā whakapakoko
Te whānautanga merekara o te tamaiti kāore he matua
Te horomia e te tohorā mō te whakarērea o tētahi misioni
Te whakangaromanga o te tāone mō ngā mahi hē
trial.answer: Te whānautanga merekara o te tamaiti kāore he matua

location.label: Huānga Matua
options: He kuao kau koura
Te Āka o te Kawenata
He rūma inoi tapu (Mihrab)
He manu kōrero (Hudhud)
He tokotoko i huri hei nakahi

outcome.label: Hua
options: Te hanganga o tētahi temepara whakahīhī
Te wehenga o te moana kia whiti ai te iwi
He tamaiti i kōrero mai i te whāngai hei tiaki i tōna mātua
Te whakakitenga mai o tētahi pukapuka atua hei ārahi i te tangata
He rangatiratanga i manaakitia e te hau me te jinn
outcome.answer: He tamaiti i kōrero mai i te whāngai hei tiaki i tōna mātua

arabic: وَإِذْ قَالَتِ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ يَـٰمَرْيَمُ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ ٱصْطَفَىٰكِ وَطَهَّرَكِ وَٱصْطَفَىٰكِ عَلَىٰ نِسَآءِ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
verse: And [mention] when the angels said, "O Mary, indeed Allāh has chosen you and purified you and chosen you above the women of the worlds. (3:42)
